title: Lower density bound for cycles with the integer slice property, n = d + 1 < P (Simon 6.8.2(2)–(6), corrected; parent V5)
statement: Assume (MR) and (VO) (types of the accepted cmc_massOn_eq_imRep_measure and dtc_vanish_off_support) and (Isor) (in-range isoperimetric filling, verbatim the second conjunct of sibling deformation). Let P, d ∈ ℕ with d + 1 < P, n := d + 1, and let ISP be the integer slice property of sibling slice_limit. Then LD_{P,d}: there is η₀ > 0 such that for every C ∈ 𝒟_n(ℝ^P) with ∂C = 0 and ISP(C), every Borel μ finite on compacts with μ(W) = M_W(C) for open W, and every μ-a.e. strongly measurable ξ with |ξ(x)(α)| ≤ |α| μ-a.e. and C(ω) = ∫ξ(ω)dμ, liminf_{r↓0} μ(B_r(x))/(ω_nrⁿ) ≥ η₀ for μ-a.e. x (ω_n = unitBallVolume n).
